profile.name: Shaun Chen
profile.bio: Liberal MP for Scarborough North 2015–2026 (resigned from Parliament August 15, 2026, citing health effects of a 2025 car accident, then ran municipally); before federal politics, a Toronto District School Board trustee from 2006 and the TDSB’s chair in 2014–2015 — the first Scarborough trustee to hold the post.

promises.text: Fight for the Sheppard Subway Extension, extending Line 4 eastward to Agincourt GO, Sheppard and McCowan station, and the Malvern community.
Secure funding from senior levels of government to build new homes.
Unlock city-owned properties and expand development in a responsible way that includes consultation with local communities and stakeholders.
Support a TTC fare cap to make rides free after 10 paid trips.
A fare freeze in the next fiscal year.
Expand the Neighbourhood Community Officer program.
Roll out School Safety Zones and Senior Safety Zones.
Advocate for the Eglinton East LRT, connecting to UTSC and then up to Malvern.
Prioritize the Morningside Avenue extension and the Steeles Avenue East widening.

expensesDetailSource.name: Council Expense Routine Disclosure — Constituency Services & Office Expenses
expensesDetailSource.publisher: City Clerk's Office, City of Toronto
expensesDetailSource.note: Figures are the City's routine disclosure of constituency services and office expenses, shown as published, by category, from 2013. This is a separate publication from the annual remuneration reports in expenses.json, with a narrower scope — office spending only, not pay, benefits or staff salaries — and the two are never added together. Amounts shown as personal funds are the member's own money, as the City reports it. Invoice-level documents stay on the City's site; category amounts link to them.
